question: In a certain code language if ‘ROHIT’ is written as ‘UKKSW’, ‘MANJU’ is written as ‘VLQER’ then how ‘NIRAJ’ will be written in that code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2775864c411b7b7effeab2b3c0808ee3cbf3ef1c3cedf2a7c11a799aea2bcd2e.png] 

The logic follows here is:

 
• **‘ROHIT’ is written as ‘UKKSW’**​

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89596acbc0501b300f109e351f9d570d8e851441cc7276b54017689c2622616d.png] 

 
• ** ‘MANJU’ is written as ‘VLQER’**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/801e1f2837a3ec62ec0265fa0055497eef883ef043bd1021cb73cc5efbb642f7.png] 

similarly,

 
• **‘NIRAJ’ will be:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1b50a0e34250ed1bd867e5224403a082c9435faed6a00abc538e9c3b3f30cdd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**KCUMS**".
